sentences.en: The movie uses stereoscopic technology to create a more immersive experience.
sentences.zh: 这部电影使用立体技术来创造更沉浸式的体验。

sentences.en: I wear glasses with special lenses for viewing stereoscopic images clearly.
sentences.zh: 我戴一副特殊镜片的眼镜来看清楚立体图像。

sentences.en: The new camera allows you to take stereoscopic photos that look very realistic.
sentences.zh: 这台新相机允许你拍摄非常逼真的立体照片。

senses.zh: 有立体视觉的； 有立体效果的
